citation.title: Experimental study on roughness effects on turbulent boundary layer flow over a two-dimensional steep hill
citation.journal: Journal of Wind Engineering and Industrial Aerodynamics

pdf.relative_local_path: docs/literature/Experimental study on roughness effects on turbulent boundary layer flow over a two-dimensional steep hill.pdf
pdf.page_numbering: one-based PDF page = printed article page

origin: Published vector figure symbols and reported numerical facts; no author-native measurements/time series supplied.

verification.data_availability_scope: Local paper and accessible publisher preview inspected; no native data files supplied/found there. This is not a claim that author data do not exist elsewhere. No author contact made.
verification.independence: Two parsing implementations plus a separate Poppler raster backend. Same analyst assigned axes/series; not two independent human readers or independent experiments.

geometry.blockage_note: The reported 5% equals Hh/ceiling height; full 1m section with 0.8m hill span gives 4%. End plates may define effective width, but dimensions are unspecified; do not assume that explanation as measured geometry.

paper: yprime=y-yh(x): local vertical above base surface, not normal distance
coordinates.delta75_note: Figure 11 preserves y/delta75; the numerical reference depth at x/H=7.5 is not reported. CSV physical heights are deliberately empty for these points.

cases.SS: smooth inflow, smooth hill and floor
cases.RR: rough inflow, rough hill and floor
cases.RS: rough inflow, smooth hill (crest data only)
cases.SR: smooth inflow, rough hill (crest data only)

unknowns.finding: No unambiguous experiment Uinf, air temperature or molecular nu is specified. The 1-8 m/s range describes probe calibration.
unknowns.consequence: Primary Reynolds-matched dimensionless validation; no dimensional U/rms scoring of Figs.9/12 without separately justified scale. Never infer scale by fitting the held-out hill.

unknowns.finding: End plates are mentioned, but height, streamwise extent, thickness and attachment/effective-section details are not specified. Roof/sidewall velocity profiles and BL conditions are not supplied.
unknowns.consequence: 2D central-plane proxy and explicit roof/span/blockage sensitivities. Full facility equivalence is unestablished.

unknowns.finding: Hill and upstream conditions are identified for RS/SR, but the downstream material coverage and exact junction layout are not specified.
unknowns.consequence: CV7 brackets hill-only patch with surroundings retained versus a change at the upstream foot persisting downstream. Freeze both scenarios before computing mixed-case scores.

unknowns.finding: No spanwise variance, epsilon profile, full time series or integral scales; normal stresses cannot determine k uniquely.
unknowns.consequence: Treat k/epsilon as inferred, retain variance/length-scale uncertainty, and reserve vertical rms for flat-flow cross-check.

unknowns.finding: delta75 is defined but its dimensional value and delta edge criterion are not given.
unknowns.consequence: Only the published y/delta75 coordinate is frozen. Shape comparisons using computed flat-floor delta75 need an explicit convention and thickness sensitivity.

unknowns.finding: No complete per-observable uncertainty budget or correlation data. Pitch-calibration deviation <±1.5% is not a measurement confidence interval.
unknowns.consequence: Keep extraction bounds separate; no formal 95% experimental-validation verdict from these data alone.

source_discrepancies.basis: Uniform 1.25H station spacing, hill foot/crest geometry and corresponding Figs.4/10.
source_discrepancies.status: inferred correction, not silently transcribed; F8 is a cross-check, not an independent primary velocity score
Preserve digitized ranges and text separately; do not truncate or claim exact agreement.

source_discrepancies.finding: Table headers print sigma_tau, while surrounding text/figure normalization is u_tau.
source_discrepancies.treatment: Transcribe Present-row values as sigma/u_tau with this contextual interpretation recorded; other papers in Table1 are not this experiment.

source_discrepancies.source: Fig.10 p.14 vs Fig.5 p.9 and p.14 text
source_discrepancies.finding: Crowded denominator typography is ambiguous; repeated profiles and text identify sigma_u/Uinf.
source_discrepancies.treatment: Use sigma_u/Uinf, cross-checked numerically against Fig.5; retain figure identity.

source_discrepancies.finding: Replotting Fig.3(e) with reported u_tau gives up to ~0.050 smooth and ~0.044 rough U/Uinf difference from Fig.3(a).
source_discrepancies.treatment: Unresolved source normalization/plot consistency; do not modify u_tau to force agreement. Fit Fig.3(a,b,c), reserve (d), and exclude (e) as a duplicate consistency check.

source_discrepancies.finding: Frame bottom is not the ordinate zero implied by labelled 0.5 and 1 ticks.
source_discrepancies.treatment: Use those labelled ticks as anchors, not the frame bottom.

excluded_source_content.coloured_dividing_peak_guides_Figs8_10: Derived guide lines, not additional independent measurements.
excluded_source_content.Fig9_intermittency_and_Figs13_14: Inventoried as context, not primary URANS targets; no claim to broadband/intermittency validation.
excluded_source_content.other_literature: No data merged from the separate Wind-Tunnel Experiments paper or later low-hill experiments.

dimensional_convention.status: analysis choice for subsequent Reynolds-matched validation; not measured dimensional speeds
dimensional_convention.Uinf_over_U_H: 1/(U_H/Uinf) from Fig3a; updated consistently with the frozen calibration version
dimensional_convention.dimensional_m_per_s_scoring: deferred until independent physical Uinf/nu information is justified; do not calibrate to hill data

revision_history.change: Final review classified four Fig6a upstream/downstream speedup series as validation; only crest series duplicate Fig6b. No point values or extraction/accuracy bounds changed; no calibration or CFD existed.
